projects.title: Yehova
projects.challenge: The client needed a modern online presence to showcase their banana leaf products and simplify the bulk ordering process. They required an intuitive way for customers to submit inquiries without the expense and maintenance overhead of a traditional backend system.
projects.solution: Developed a fast, responsive landing page using Next.js and Tailwind CSS that displays product catalogs and company details. Integrated an automated submission pipeline that routes customer orders directly into Google Sheets, delivering a lightweight, cost-effective solution deployed seamlessly on Vercel.
features: Responsive landing page with modern UI and smooth user experience
Product showcase with business information and contact details
Order form integrated with Google Sheets for automatic order collection
SEO-friendly Next.js architecture for improved discoverability
Fast deployment and continuous updates using Vercel and Git

projects.title: NexTrade (Global B2B Trade Network)
projects.challenge: Bulk product sourcing across international markets is often fragmented, leaving businesses reliant on limited suppliers and vulnerable to supply chain disruptions. Finding verified global trade partners typically involves complex research across disjointed communication channels.
projects.solution: Engineered a cross-platform B2B marketplace using Next.js, Supabase, and PostgreSQL to connect manufacturers, exporters, and bulk buyers worldwide. The platform enables users to discover verified partners, issue multi-supplier RFQs, and manage global supply chain connections through a unified web and mobile interface.
features: Global buyer and supplier directory with advanced search and filtering
Bulk RFQ (Request for Quotation) system for sourcing products from multiple suppliers
Company verification and business profiles to build trust
Real-time messaging and inquiry management
Product catalog with categories, certifications, and export capabilities
Supplier comparison based on pricing, ratings, and delivery regions
Cross-platform web and Android application using Capacitor
Admin dashboard for verification, moderation, and platform management

projects.title: Habit Tracker (TrackerX)
projects.challenge: Standard habit tracking applications frequently lack engaging retention mechanics, leading to low long-term user consistency and limited visibility into personal growth trends. Users require an interactive approach to build routine accountability effectively.
projects.solution: Built a gamified web application that transforms daily habit completion into a progression system powered by dynamic experience points (XP) and level mechanics. Utilizing Next.js and Supabase, the app delivers real-time analytics dashboards that visualize personal progress trends and habit streaks over time.
features: XP-based gamification system with real-time level progression
Interactive habits dashboard with automated completion tracking
Visual analytics charts tracking historical user consistency
Secure user authentication and cloud data syncing via Supabase
Fully responsive user interface tailored for daily mobile and desktop use

projects.title: Trading Research App (Sentinel)
projects.challenge: Traders often battle scattered market data and slow, manual chart evaluation processes when attempting to conduct rapid technical research across fluctuating assets. Efficient decision-making requires consolidated market indicators and streamlined data rendering.
projects.solution: Created a data-driven research application combining a FastAPI backend with a React dynamic frontend to ingest and parse real-time market feeds. The platform renders customizable technical charts via Recharts, empowering traders to monitor trends, evaluate patterns, and accelerate analytical research.
features: Real-time market data retrieval via external financial API integration
Interactive candlestick and technical indicator charts powered by Recharts
Fast API backend for efficient processing of high-volume market datasets
Customizable watchlist and asset search capabilities
Responsive trading analytical dashboard optimized for desktop monitoring

projects.title: Quotes Display App
projects.challenge: Users seeking quick daily motivation often face heavy, ad-cluttered quote applications that suffer from slow load times and convoluted navigation setups.
projects.solution: Developed a minimal, highly responsive React application focused on instantly rendering inspirational quotes upon user interaction. The platform utilizes lightweight state management to fetch dynamic content without unnecessary dynamic layout shifts or performance lag.
features: Instant random quote generation with single-click refreshing
Clean, distraction-free minimalist user interface
One-click text copy functionality for seamless content sharing
Fast client-side state handling with zero load latency
Fully responsive layout optimized across all modern viewports

projects.title: Recipe Finder App
projects.challenge: Finding tailored cooking recipes based on specific home ingredients often requires navigating ad-dense websites with complex filtering options.
projects.solution: Engineered an intuitive React application that allows users to query dietary preferences and kitchen ingredients to surface tailored cooking recipes instantaneously. The interface provides structured instructions, preparation timing, and clear ingredient lists.
features: Dynamic ingredient and keyword-based recipe search querying
Detailed recipe views complete with step-by-step instructions and ingredient lists
Client-side API caching to prevent redundant data requests
Categorized search filter presets for quick meal discovery
Mobile-friendly interface built for convenient kitchen usage
